thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: autoscaler failed to scale for inference-pool-us-west-2 — queue growth > 4k requests, avg token latency spiking. scale_event=ScaleLimitReached, available_gpus=0. Details: https://internal.monitoring/redwood/alerts/5509991234

sre_oncall_maria: Oncall here, looking. Any customer-facing errors?

cs_zoe: Got reports from two enterprise customers — API latencies >5s, intermittent 429s from hosted inference. CS ticket numbers: #CS-1189, #CS-1190.

maria: Pulling metrics — queue length 4.2k, token throughput dropped 70%, cluster GPU util 96-99%. Autoscaler attempted to scale to 12 but was capped at 8 by policy. Logs:
```
autoscaler: scale_attempt -> desired=12, max=8, result=ScaleLimitReached
scheduler: placement_fail: 24 pods pending placement, reason=AllocationFragmentation, MIG_allocate_failed
```

devon_platform: We have known fragmentation in the MIG pool — lots of 1g and 7g slices mixed, leads to pockets that can't host new largest-inference pods. I can bump max temporarily to 16 but if scheduler can't pack it won't help. Suggest: (1) temporary burst eviction of non-critical batch jobs, (2) force repack of MIG pools.

ops-bot: Executing command: `respool evict --pool inference-burst --grace 30s`

ops-bot: Eviction started, expected ~45s. 12 burst jobs queued for restart.

maria: Eviction freed 3 GPU slices. Queue dropped to 3.1k but still backlogged. Scheduler logs now:
```
podX: InsufficientVGPUs: required=14g, available_pools=[1g,7g,1g], reason=fragmented-capacity
```

devon_platform: Starting emergency repack job (non-disruptive preferred). Command below — will attempt to consolidate MIG allocations and co-locate low-priority workloads to free contiguous slices.
```
./tools/repack --region us-west-2 --pool inference-pools --mode=aggressive --timeout=10m
job_id=repak-5509-01
```

infra_paul: repack job accepted. Kickoff logs: migrating 18 pods, expected GPU churn = 4 GPUs. Watch for transient evictions.

maria: repack job running. Posting scheduler update in 2m.

ops-bot: repack job repak-5509-01: step1 complete, 9 pods moved. transient-evictions=6.

maria: Good progress. After step1, available contiguous 14g slice found on node-22, placing 3 waiting inference pods. Queue down to 1.4k.

cs_zoe: Customer impact update: latency still degraded for ~10% of calls; escalated customers notified with ETA ~15m. :white_check_mark: some customers report partial recovery.

infra_paul: repack job complete. reclaimed 2 full GPUs equivalent. Confirming scheduler can now place previously stuck pods.

maria: Queue drained to steady-state 200 reqs. token latency back to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated.

devon_platform: Root cause summary in-thread: mixed MIG sizing + conservative autoscaler max cap. Autoscaler hit configured hard cap (8) while fragmentation prevented efficient packing -> backlog growth -> throttling. Temporary mitigations: burstpool eviction + repack.

maria: Immediate action items:
- increase autoscaler hard cap to 16 for us-west-2 (temp) -> owner @devon_platform
- add alert for scheduler placement failures (AllocationFragmentation) -> owner @infra_paul
- run a targeted repack during low-traffic window to permanently consolidate MIGs -> owner @devon_paul
- CS follow-up to affected customers with post-mortem -> owner @cs_zoe

devon_platform: Done: increased max nodes to 16 for emergency window. Will roll back after repack verification.

maria: Handoff: night oncall @lee_noc — summary and what to watch: placement-fail alerts, queue growth threshold 500+, repack job schedule. Full notes in ops ticket #OPS-3182.

lee_noc: Got it, thanks. I'll monitor and run an automated repack if placement alerts fire. Also will keep the temporary cap at 16 until 03:00 UTC unless told otherwise.

cs_zoe: I'll send updated customer messages and include mitigation steps + ETA for permanent fix.

maria: Closing thread — incident mitigated, creating postmortem draft. Attach logs/commands to OPS ticket. :memo:
